summary: Prudential plc filed a Form 6-K announcing a strategic repositioning of its India operations via a controlling stake acquisition. Prudential agreed to acquire a 75% stake in Bharti Life Insurance Company from Bharti Life Ventures Pvt Ltd and 360 ONE Asset Management for an initial cash consideration of INR 3,500 crore (~$389 million) payable at completion. The transaction is subject to regulatory approvals; Prudential will reduce its ICICI Prudential Life stake to under 10% to comply. The deal will be funded from existing resources, with potential divestment proceeds supporting growth. Watch for regulatory timelines and any required ICICIPru Life stake sale timeline.
